experiment: Phase-4E / Subagent-C: Prefetch Distance Variants for IQ3_XXS MMVQ
kernel: mul_mat_vec_q<18, 1, false, 1, depth>  (IQ3_XXS, ncols_dst=1, has_fusion=false, nwarps=1, prefetch_depth in {0,1,2,4,-1})

C4.description: Full #pragma unroll on the trip loop

key_finding: The __builtin_prefetch calls in C1/C2/C3 are completely eliminated by the compiler (no s_prefetch or global_load instructions appear in the SASS). The C1/C2/C3 variants end up equivalent to 'LDS-staged grid' (the 1KB iq3xxs_grid is loaded into LDS once per workgroup, then read from LDS instead of L1). The C4 #pragma unroll hint is also ignored because blocks_per_row_x is a runtime value.

verdict.does_prefetch_help: NO. C1/C2/C3 are 2.4-4.3% SLOWER on ffn_down and 6.5-8.3% SLOWER on gateup. C4 is statistically indistinguishable from V0 (compiler refuses to unroll a dynamic-count loop).
verdict.at_what_depth: Increasing prefetch depth (1 -> 2 -> 4) makes things slightly WORSE due to extra LDS reads. C3 (depth 4) is the slowest variant on both shapes.
verdict.at_what_vgpr_cost: C1/C2/C3 add 5 VGPRs (76 -> 81 for ffn_down, 33 -> 83 for ffn_gateup), but the cost is not the VGPR pressure - the LDS reads from the staged grid create 30-200x more LDS wait cycles which dominate.
verdict.was_bottleneck_insufficient_inflight_loa: REFUTED. The C1/C2/C3 variants in this harness have the same 14 in-flight global_loads as V0 (6 K-loop loads after the 8 grid loads were moved to LDS-staging). The per-trip load count went DOWN, not UP. The K-loop is NOT load-bound; per subagent-A's analysis, it is bound by the 8-deep v_dot4 chain (v_dot4_i32_iu8) which is on the compute path, not the load path.
verdict.reference_to_subagent_A: Subagent-A established that vmcnt(0) at the trip boundary is REQUIRED (L14 consumed 4 instructions later by v_xor_b32 v52,v58,v17). This subagent's findings are consistent: we confirmed via SASS inspection that the existing V0 wait placement is the minimum, and adding 'prefetch' loads does not relax the wait. The latency is on the compute path (8-deep v_dot4 chain), not the load path. The real win per subagent-A's recommendation is to split the 8-deep v_dot4 chain into two 4-deep chains into independent accumulators, sum at the end - not to add more loads or relax waits.

limitations.compiler_elided_prefetches: All __builtin_prefetch calls in C1/C2/C3 are completely eliminated by the compiler (verified by SASS inspection: zero s_prefetch or extra global_load instructions). The variants effectively test LDS-staged grid (subagent-B V1), not actual trip prefetch. An attempt was made to issue real global_load via inline asm volatile, but the SGPR register pressure caused the kernel to clobber the loaded addresses and fault at runtime; the simpler __builtin_prefetch approach was kept for the final report because it produces bit-exact results and clearly demonstrates the compiler's no-op treatment of the prefetch hint.
limitations.C4_unroll_ignored: The compiler does not actually unroll the K-loop because blocks_per_row_x is a runtime value. C4's code is structurally identical to V0; the test confirms that explicit unroll hints cannot be applied to this dynamic loop without source refactoring (e.g., switching to a fixed-trip unroll with a tail loop).
